title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Stadtweite Durchsuchungsmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors carried out 14 search warrants across six Berlin districts against suspected illegal trade in semi-automatic firearms, involving over 300 officers. Seven suspects aged 22 to 52 were provisionally arrested and two firearms with ammunition were seized.
